Storage

Also keep a copy in a device folder
GitHub only. Every document is also saved as a real file in a folder you choose, so you can work with GitHub and device storage at the same time. Edits you make to these files are uploaded on the next sync.
Your documents are saved as normal files in a folder you choose, so they show up in your file manager and other apps (Syncthing…). Edits made outside the app appear after a refresh.
Documents are kept privately inside this browser on this device (IndexedDB). No account or internet needed. Clearing site data removes them, so export a backup now and then.

Help Guide
Everything this editor can do, section by section.
Your document
  • Title: tap the name at the top to rename the document.
  • Save and status: the label beside Save shows whether your changes are stored.
  • Undo and Redo: the two arrows reverse or restore your last edit.
  • Search: find text, replace one or all matches, with Match case and Whole word options.
  • Reading mode: the book icon gives a distraction-free view.
  • Menu (three dots): extra options such as Full Screen.
  • Status bar: page count, word count and zoom.
  • Collapse arrow: hides or shows the toolbar for more writing room.
Home
  • Font, size, bold, italic, underline, color and highlight.
  • Alignment, spacing, bullets, numbering and indents.
  • Styles and headings, plus find and replace.
Insert
  • Pictures, tables, shapes, symbols, links and page breaks.
Draw
  • Write or sketch freehand using the pen tools.
Design
  • Themes, colors and fonts that set the look of the page.
Layout
  • Margins, orientation, page size, columns and breaks.
References
  • Table of contents, footnotes, citations and captions.
Review
  • Spelling and grammar checks, comments and tracked changes.
View
  • Print layout shows real pages. Web layout shows one continuous page.
  • Marks shows or hides paragraph marks.
  • Zoom: minus, Fit, 100% and plus.
AI tools
  • Editing: select text, then choose an option to make it clearer and smoother.
  • Tone: rewrite as Formal or Friendly.
  • Translate: convert the selection to another language.
  • Summarize: condense the selection or the whole document.
  • Continue: keep writing from where you stopped.
  • Ask AI: give an instruction or ask a question about your text.
  • Free Chats: copies your text and opens a free chat site. Paste it there, then paste the answer back.
  • AI Settings: choose the provider and add a key.
Tips
  • Select text before using Editing, Tone or Translate.
  • Use Print layout to check how pages will look when printed.
  • Turn on Auto in the menu so your work saves as you type.
